outcome.technical: drive-phase.py: writer_settle (called in advance after writer_wait) settles each writer dispatch whose record holds a session result, once: HEAD is recorded per dispatch (open_dispatch head=tree_head) and a moved HEAD is the new decision writer-committed (block|retry) naming the commit, filing nothing; otherwise file_writer_return runs stamp-verification.py red with red_args (now the one argv builder submit's red_block also uses, through red_run) over writer_test_command (the resolved gate entry naming a tests.add file, the same two readers audit-lookup.red_command asks), locks payload.testDigest in the writer state, takes the stamp, and files through audit-task.py file-return a return with gates {}, diffPaths (git status through _config.git_to_plan, records left out), redFirst (helper source + testDigest), stamp, writerClaim = the stream's last result text verbatim, and the case-binding gap fields. No derivable command -> could-not-prove naming the basis; gate-only with no tests.add -> not-attempted. A resume round whose session changed a locked test file is re-proved (reprove) and noted on the task listing the files. close_task refuses the commit with the new decision tests-moved (reprove|block) naming the changed files while locked_paths_now (_journal_io.file_hash over the locked paths) differs; --answer reprove re-proves, relocks and re-runs the recorded gate (the per-task reviewer already filed, so advance would not re-gate). stamp-verification.py: red's payload gains testDigest (sha256:<hex> of each declared test file's bytes + a digest over the list), and declared_tests() factors the scope read _red_scope used. Module docstrings and reference/execute-task.md state the drive-side order. Tests: wf1-wf5, wl1-wl4 new in tests/test_drive_phase.py (wf/wl blocks; ws2/ws16 no longer file as an executor - the stub now writes files, can commit, and ends with a result text); sdr1-sdr2 new in tests/test_stamp_verification.py. Runs: test_drive_phase 441/441 and test_stamp_verification 308/308 (exit 0 each); 8 mutations in throwaway copies each red (lock check skipped -> wl1,wl2; lock always moved -> wf3; no commit check -> wf5; claim stripped -> wf1; resume re-proof skipped -> wl3,wl4; no-command reads proved -> wf4; red_args without --derive-introduces -> sdr1; testDigest dropped -> sdr2). Committed-copy sweep: 189/191 files ok, red only in tools/check-example-ledgers.py and tools/measure-context.py, the two the orchestrator named as allowed. ruff and vermin clean.
outcome.descriptive: After a writer session the drive proves red-first through a throwaway git tree, locks the test digest, takes the stamp and files the return itself, quoting the writer's last message as a claim

wl1-wl4: a test file edited after the proof makes the commit refuse with tests-moved naming the file, reprove re-proves and closes; a resume round that changes a test file re-proves and notes the file, and the close then commits
